issues.description: The example usages in the template Main.java instantiate Seal, Pig, and Goat with two constructor arguments (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the intended design (problem statement and solution) expects each Animal subclass to have a constructor that initializes only the name attribute (single String parameter). This mismatch can confuse students who copy the example Main and then fail to compile when implementing the animal constructors as specified.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template Main.java example with the intended one-argument constructors by changing the example instantiations to use only the name (e.g. Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if the exercise intends to include an additional attribute, update the problem statement and the solution constructors to accept the second parameter and document the attribute in the UML/specification.
